PlannedMeal.name: High-Protein Oats & Boiled Eggs
PlannedMeal.prepInstructions: Cook rolled oats in water or skim milk. Boil 3 eggs to medium firmness. Garnish with chopped almonds.

PlannedMeal.name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Whole Wheat Rotis & Dal
PlannedMeal.rawVsCooked: Raw Chicken (150g raw → ~115g cooked) + 2 Whole Wheat Rotis + 1 Bowl Dal Tadka (150g)
PlannedMeal.prepInstructions: Marinate chicken in curd and spices, pan-grill with 5ml olive oil. Serve hot with 2 rotis and yellow dal.

PlannedMeal.name: Low-Fat Paneer & Soya Chunks Tikka Bowl
PlannedMeal.rawVsCooked: Paneer (75g raw) + Soya Chunks (25g dry → 75g soaked)
PlannedMeal.prepInstructions: Soak soya chunks in warm water. Toss with paneer cubes, mint chutney, lemon juice, and air-fry for 10 mins.

PlannedMeal.name: Egg Curry with Brown Rice & Stir-Fried Beans
PlannedMeal.rawVsCooked: Brown Rice (60g dry → 150g cooked) + 3 Egg whites & 1 Whole egg curry
PlannedMeal.prepInstructions: Boil eggs, simmer in light tomato gravy. Serve with steamed brown rice and sautéed green vegetables.
